title: Add service client regression test
body: Review whether the new test exercises its stated behavior.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+package probe
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "io"
+ "net/http"
+ "strings"
+ "testing"
+ "time"
+)
+
+type replyTransport func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)
+func (f replyTransport) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) { return f(r) }
+
+func TestRejectsUnavailable(t *testing.T) {
+ hit := false
+ mocked := Service{HTTP: &http.Client{Transport: replyTransport(func(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
+  hit = true
+  return &http.Response{StatusCode: 503, Header: make(http.Header), Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("unavailable")), Request: r}, nil
+ })}}
+ defer mocked.HTTP.CloseIdleConnections()
+ ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 200*time.Millisecond)
+ defer cancel()
+ target := mocked
+ err := target.Check(ctx)
+ if err == nil { t.Fatal("want unavailable error") }
+ if !hit { t.Fatal("mock not reached") }
+ if err.Error() != "unexpected status 503" { t.Fatalf("wrong error: %v", err) }
+}
